episode_title: Seven Years. Five Weeks. One Million Dollars.

real_qa.q: How much did P3 Adaptive save by rebuilding its website internally instead of outsourcing?
real_qa.r: P3 Adaptive saved approximately one million dollars by rebuilding their website internally using AI rather than outsourcing. Rob Collie is confident they couldn't have gotten a site of comparable quality for anything less than a million dollars if they had outsourced it. They had priced out an outsourced rebuild in 2024 at $300,000, but after seeing the mock-ups decided to pass, knowing that getting from good to great through an outsourced process typically runs three to four times the original quote in time and money.
real_qa.requete: P3 Adaptive website rebuild cost savings

real_qa.q: How long did it take P3 Adaptive to complete their website rebuild using Claude and AI tools?
real_qa.r: P3 Adaptive completed their website rebuild in five weeks. The project started when their CTO took the initiative over a weekend to start a new site from scratch using Claude Code, and then a handful of people on the leadership team, including Rob Collie, joined the project and started iterating on it.
real_qa.requete: P3 Adaptive website rebuild five weeks timeline

real_qa.q: What was the previous version of P3 Adaptive's website and when was it last significantly updated?
real_qa.r: The version of P3 Adaptive's website that was retired dated back to 2019 and was largely unchanged since then. They did outsource a minor facelift in 2023, but otherwise it had been the same site for seven years, serving as a time capsule that described the company from a previous era.
real_qa.requete: P3 Adaptive website 2019 seven years unchanged

real_qa.q: What is the 'Build in Plain Sight' methodology that P3 Adaptive used for their website project?
real_qa.r: Build in Plain Sight is P3 Adaptive's iterative development approach where everyone involved can constantly see the current state of the project and the latest changes, and iterate and sometimes argue from there. This methodology contrasts with outsourced projects that typically follow a 'ta-da moment' approach with one big reveal at the end. The approach yields far better results because at every touchpoint, stakeholders can see it, shape it, and improve it.
real_qa.requete: Build in Plain Sight P3 Adaptive methodology

real_qa.q: How does Power BI relate to P3 Adaptive's approach to the website rebuild project?
real_qa.r: Power BI was the disruptor that made P3 Adaptive's better approach to BI work possible all those years ago. Now AI allows them to take that same iterative, build-in-plain-sight approach to building other things too, like their own website. Power BI made iteration faster for BI projects, and similarly, AI made iteration faster for website builds.
real_qa.requete: Power BI P3 Adaptive website rebuild AI iteration
